finding.summary: Font-readiness assertion is still vacuous when the Google Fonts stylesheet itself fails to load
finding.evidence: The todo doc for this change (docs/tasks/active/20260811-visual-inter-font-race-todo.md:75-76) claims the new per-family "at least one face reached loaded" assertion "is what makes an unreachable CDN fail rather than pass". But the awaited set is derived *entirely* from `document.fonts` (registry(), line 385-396), and every face in this app comes from remote stylesheets (packages/frontend/index.html:12 and font-catalog.ts:103 — grep found no local `@font-face` in packages/frontend). If the css2 stylesheet request itself fails/is blocked (404/429/no network/DNS), no `@font-face` rules exist, so `registry()` is empty, `pending()` iterates nothing and returns `[]`, and `settlePass` reports success. Capture then proceeds with fallback glyphs, `webFontFailures` stays empty, and the new `if (updateBaseline && webFontFailures.length > 0)` guard at line ~624 ("Refusing to record baselines from fallback glyphs") never fires — i.e. the guard is vacuous in exactly the scenario it advertises. `refetchPass` has the same hole: with zero matching links it rewrites nothing and returns 0, which the caller ignores. The harness's own assertion therefore passes independently of whether the behavior it checks (usable webfonts) holds.

verdict.reason: The described code is not present. There is no `registry()`/`pending()` pair in packages/frontend/scripts (grep: no matches), and the awaited set is not derived from `document.fonts` — it is the hard-coded floor `REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS` (verify-visual-browser.mjs:374-378). `missingRequired()` iterates that floor and its first branch is exactly the failed-stylesheet case: `if (faces.length === 0) missing.push("<family> (no @font-face registered)")` (verify-visual-browser.mjs:444-447). So a blocked/404 css2 request produces non-empty `missing`, the poll never breaks as settled (:491), `webFontFailures.push` runs (:546), and the `updateBaseline && webFontFailures.length > 0` refusal at :707-712 (plus the non-zero exit at :821-823) does fire in the advertised scenario. The claim that a zero-result `refetchPass` is ignored is also false: :552-561 records the failure and returns with an explicit error. The doc lines cited (docs/tasks/active/20260811-visual-inter-font-race-todo.md:84-96) are the "Follow-up 2" section describing the registry-derived vacuity as the problem that was fixed, with the completed floor-based plan at :110-121 matching the current script.

finding.summary: No floor of expected families/weights: nothing asserts the fonts the baselines were recorded with are actually present
finding.evidence: The previous code kept an explicit `VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES`/`VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS` floor; the diff deletes it and derives everything from the page registry, with the comment "the wait cannot drift from them". There is now no assertion anywhere that Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono (the families the baselines were recorded against, index.html:12) were registered at all — the very families whose absence caused the original slides-theme-panel / slides-pickers drift documented in the todo. A minimal non-derived expectation (e.g. `Inter` must appear in the registry with a `loaded` face) is what would keep the check from passing on an empty registry. Searched: whole script for any hard-coded family/weight list, `grep` for VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES / expected fonts across the repo, packages/frontend/tests for visual-harness font assertions.

verdict.reason: The absence claim is false in this repository. `verify-visual-browser.mjs:374-378` contains an explicit, non-derived floor `REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS = [{Inter,[400,500,600,700]},{Fraunces,[500,600,700]},{JetBrains Mono,[400,500]}]`, mirroring the css2 query at `packages/frontend/index.html:12`. It is asserted positively, including exactly the empty-registry case the finding says is unguarded: `:444-447` fails with "no @font-face registered" when a required family has zero faces (with a comment explaining `fonts.check()` would falsely answer true there), `:451-453` requires at least one face at status `loaded`, and `:455-459` requires `document.fonts.check()` to pass at every declared weight. The floor is wired in at `:519-523`, failures are collected into `webFontFailures` (`:546`, `:556`), reported at `:694-705`, block baseline recording at `:707-712`, and fail the run via `process.exit(1)` at `:821-823`. The reviewer's greps missed it because the constant is named `REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS`, not `VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES`/`VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS`.
